segments.excerpt: A. The Parties wish to exchange confidential information for the following purpose: Mutual NDA to share formulation data for a joint study (the "Purpose").
B. In connection with the Purpose, confidential and proprietary information may be disclosed. Each Party may act as both Disclosing Party and Receiving Party.

validated_output.extraction_notes: Section 11 is a "General/Miscellaneous" section mixing distinct topics, so its sub-clauses (11.1–11.10) are labelled individually rather than the parent. Section 8.3 is notable: it explicitly carves out confidentiality-breach liability from any limitation-of-liability cap, which is an unusually strong pro-disclosing-party provision. Section 4.3 contains an explicit AI/ML training prohibition on Confidential Information, which is a modern and noteworthy addition to a pharma NDA.
